SHIOMORI CAMPUS ASSET ATTRIBUTION

Japanese Torii gate Game Asset by Bazylonator
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/e12d2fa1b2b94928b8b87cb7787e2462
Creative Commons Attribution 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Changes: node transforms baked, scaled and oriented for the coastal setting;
Unreal material conversion, collision and generated LODs.

Small Japanese Shrine by SamRi (Samiri)
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/b78796a957a24cb092092a15efcec040
Creative Commons Attribution 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Changes: mesh parts combined with original materials and UVs retained; scaled
and placed on the peninsula; Unreal material conversion, collision and LODs.

These two files were obtained from Ai2's public Objaverse archive.
https://huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/objaverse
Dataset attribution: Deitke et al., Objaverse: A Universe of Annotated 3D Objects,
2022. Database license: https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/by/1-0/
The individual objects retain the authors' CC-BY 4.0 licenses above.
